Ok. So what this mod does right now, is, well, It changes the color of the farmer's Eyelashes/Eyebrows. [size=2]
(I can't really tell which one they are. It's really hard to tell when they're like, Two pixels tall.)

[/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][size=4]Content Patcher[/size][/url][size=4]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]
